figures: 1. Figure 1: Self-Spec Orchestration Overview. The process: NL request → SpecDesigner (one-time schema creation) → SpecInstantiator (populate schema) → FMInterviewer ↔ SpecApplier (Q&A loop for any TBD fields) → FMConfirmer (await explicit "CONFIRM") → SpecExecutor (generate code). The FMInterviewer–SpecApplier loop repeats until no TBD remains and the user (or system) confirms the spec.
results_section: 1. We observe that for two of the models (GPT-4o and Claude 3.7), the Self-Spec approach yields a higher pass@1 compared to the native direct generation.
